guideContent.strategyOverview: Mono-green elfball + cheat-strategy hybrid. The 21-elf core (Llanowar Elves, Elvish Mystic, Heritage Druid, Priest of Titania, Marwyn the Nurturer, Elvish Archdruid, Imperious Perfect, Springbloom Druid, Circle of Dreams Druid, Dwynen Gilt-Leaf Daen, plus token producers and existing utility elves) generates explosive early mana — Priest of Titania and Marwyn routinely tap for 5-8 each by turn 4, scaled by Heritage Druid's tap-three-elves-for-{G}{G}{G} burst. Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Lodge untap key dorks for double activations, and Skyshroud Claim / Cultivate / Crop Rotation provide non-creature ramp resilient to wipes. The tap-fodder feeds Eladamri's commander ability (tap 2 creatures + {G} to reveal top, cheat any creature into play) — with 21 elves and 40+ creatures total, Eladamri activates 2-3 times per turn. Sensei's Divining Top arranges the top of library for guaranteed creature reveals. The cheat plan deploys haymakers without paying their costs: Craterhoof Behemoth (anthem trample), Ghalta Stampede Tyrant (deploys all creatures from hand), Avenger of Zendikar (token swarm), Apex Altisaur (ETB fight + Enrage chain for removal), Worldspine Wurm (15/15 trample that dies into three 5/5 wurms with trample), Tendershoot Dryad, and Void Winnower. Last March of the Ents is the uncounterable closer — draws a hand and dumps it. Glimpse of Nature with Heritage Druid + Quirion Ranger chains 5-8 draws in a single turn. Champions of the Perfect, Guardian Project, and Leaf-Crowned Visionary form a triple-draw stack on creature casts. Hunter's Talent and Apex Altisaur cover the removal slots. Bracket 2 build leaning toward 3 in raw consistency, with the cheat package giving the deck explosive top-end without warping the curve.

winConditions.title: Craterhoof Overrun
winConditions.description: Flood the board with elves and tokens, then resolve Craterhoof Behemoth. With 8+ creatures, each gains +9/+9 and trample — a typical board of 10 creatures swings for 100+ damage. Fierce Empath tutors Craterhoof directly to hand. Eladamri's ability #3 can cheat it onto the battlefield from hand, bypassing the 8-mana cost entirely.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Primary win condition — tutorable, cheatable finisher

winConditions.title: Ezuri Repeatable Overrun
winConditions.description: Activate Ezuri's overrun ability ({2}{G}{G}{G}: Elf creatures you control get +3/+3 and trample until end of turn) multiple times with massive mana from Priest of Titania or Elvish Archdruid. With 8 elves in play, Priest taps for 8 green — enough for one overrun activation. Two activations gives +6/+6 to every elf, typically lethal with 6+ attacking elves.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Repeatable pump finisher leveraging elf mana density

winConditions.title: Ghalta Mass Deploy
winConditions.description: Ghalta's ETB puts all creatures from your hand onto the battlefield. Cheat Ghalta in via Eladamri's ability #3, then deploy 3-5 creatures from hand simultaneously — including Craterhoof Behemoth for an immediate lethal swing. Even without Craterhoof, flooding the board with 5+ additional bodies often ends the game next combat.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Cheatable mass-deploy into Craterhoof line

winConditions.title: Last March of the Ents
winConditions.description: Uncounterable sorcery that draws cards equal to your greatest creature toughness (typically 5-11), then puts any number of creature cards from hand onto the battlefield. With a large board, draw into Craterhoof and dump it plus every other creature in hand onto the battlefield. Functionally a one-card combo that refills your hand and deploys lethal threats.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Uncounterable draw + mass deploy win condition

winConditions.title: Void Winnower Lock
winConditions.description: Cheat Void Winnower onto the battlefield via Eladamri's ability #3. Opponents can't cast spells with even mana values (including 0, 2, 4, 6, 8) or block with even-cost creatures. This locks out roughly half the spells in any opponent's deck while providing an 11/9 body. Follow up with any combat step for lethal while opponents scramble for odd-cost answers.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Cheatable stax piece that locks out half the format

winConditions.title: Tyvar Exponential Pump
winConditions.description: Tyvar's activated ability ({3}{G}{G}) gives all creatures +X/+X where X is the greatest power among creatures you control. With 10+ mana from Priest of Titania or Elvish Archdruid, activate twice: the first activation with a 5-power creature gives +5/+5, making the greatest power 10. The second activation gives +10/+10. A board of 6 elves swings for 90+ damage with trample from Ezuri.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Exponential pump finisher leveraging elf mana

winConditions.title: Apex Altisaur Removal Chain
winConditions.description: Cheat Apex Altisaur into play via Eladamri (tap two creatures + {G}, reveal Apex on top). ETB fight kills a creature ≤10 toughness; if Apex takes damage in the fight, Enrage triggers another fight. With multiple opposing threats and a 10/10 body that survives most fights, Apex can resolve 2-3 fights per resolution — clearing the way for Craterhoof or Ghalta the following turn.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Removal-as-finisher line via cheat (DEC-83)

synergies.title: Top Manipulation Engine
synergies.description: Sensei's Divining Top lets you look at the top 3 cards and reorder them. Combined with Eladamri's always-visible top card and creature topcasting, you arrange a creature on top to cast for free, then rearrange again. Near-guaranteed creature every turn. Top's draw-and-put-on-library ability also shuffles itself away when you need a fresh top card.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Core library manipulation synergy

synergies.title: Elf Bounce Loop
synergies.description: Wirewood Symbiote returns an elf to hand to untap a creature. Bounce Dwynen's Elite, untap Priest of Titania or Elvish Archdruid. Recast Dwynen's Elite to create another 1/1 elf token. Net: one extra elf token per turn plus an untap of your best mana elf. With Formidable Speaker, each bounce is a creature tutor.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Repeatable ETB value engine

synergies.title: Skullclamp Token Draw
synergies.description: Equip Skullclamp to any 1/1 elf token — it gets +1/-1, dies immediately, draw 2 cards. Dwynen's Elite, Elfsworn Giant, and Tendershoot Dryad all create 1/1 tokens that convert to 2 cards each for {1} equip cost. With steady token production, Skullclamp draws 4-6 cards per turn cycle.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Token sacrifice draw engine

synergies.title: Formidable Tutor Loop
synergies.description: Formidable Speaker ETB: discard a card to tutor any creature to hand. Wirewood Symbiote bounces Speaker and untaps Eladamri or a mana elf. Recast Speaker to tutor again. Each loop tutors a creature while the untap ability provides extra mana or an Eladamri activation. Assembles any combo or finisher in 2-3 turns.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Repeatable creature tutor chain

synergies.title: Champions Draw Engine
synergies.description: Champions of the Perfect draws a card whenever you cast a creature spell. Eladamri casts creatures from the top of the library — each one triggers Champions for a free draw. With 45% creature density, nearly every other card cast triggers a draw. Combined with Guardian Project, each creature cast draws 2 cards.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Topcasting draw synergy

synergies.title: Landfall Token Swarm
synergies.description: Each land drop triggers all three: Elfsworn Giant makes a 1/1 elf, Scute Swarm makes an insect (or copy of itself with 6+ lands), Springheart Nantuko makes an insect or creature copy when bestowed. A single land drop creates 3+ tokens. With Parallel Lives, each land drop creates 6+ tokens.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Triple landfall token engine

synergies.title: Tutor Redundancy
synergies.description: Three creature tutors with distinct modes. Fierce Empath finds CMC 6+ to hand. Finale of Devastation searches library or graveyard and at X≥10 gives all creatures +X/+X and haste — a second Craterhoof effect. Nature's Rhythm tutors at sorcery speed for XGG, then recasts from graveyard via Harmonize (tap a creature to reduce cost by its power). With this deck's mana, Finale at X=10 is trivial, and Nature's Rhythm gives two uses for one card slot.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Triple tutor package filling the deck's biggest strategic gap

synergies.title: Eladamri Cheat Line
synergies.description: Fierce Empath tutors any creature with mana value 6+ to hand — find Craterhoof, Ghalta, or Void Winnower. Then tap Eladamri plus two creatures, reveal the tutored creature from hand, and put it directly onto the battlefield bypassing its mana cost. A 3-mana Fierce Empath becomes a 3-mana Craterhoof.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Tutor-to-cheat win line

synergies.title: Nursery Landfall Swarm
synergies.description: Each land drop triggers all three: Sapling Nursery creates a 3/4 Treefolk with reach, Elfsworn Giant creates a 1/1 Elf, Scute Swarm creates an insect or copy. A single land produces 3+ tokens with 7+ total stats. Parallel Lives doubles all three. Shigeki, Jukai Visionary's repeatable land-fetch ability triggers the entire package at will.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Landfall token army synergy (DEC-73)

synergies.title: Mana Amplification Engine
synergies.description: Badgermole Cub adds {G} per creature tapped for mana. Priest of Titania tapping for 8 now produces 9. With Elven Chorus making all creatures mana dorks, a board of 10 creatures produces 20{G} instead of 10{G}. Powers Finale of Devastation at X=10+ and multiple Ezuri overrun activations in a single turn.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Mana amplification synergy (DEC-73)

synergies.title: Heritage Druid Burst
synergies.description: Heritage Druid taps three untapped elves to add {G}{G}{G}. Imperious Perfect and Elvish Warmaster generate elf tokens on creature ETBs to fuel the activation. Quirion Ranger bounces a Forest to untap a tapped elf — chain a second Heritage Druid activation in the same turn. Easily produces 6-9 mana on turn 3-4 with 4-5 elves on board.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Elf-tribal burst engine (DEC-83)

synergies.title: Marwyn Counter Engine
synergies.description: Marwyn gains a +1/+1 counter every time another elf enters. Imperious Perfect and Elvish Warmaster create elf tokens, each triggering Marwyn. By turn 5, Marwyn often has 5-8 power and taps for an equivalent amount of green — a self-contained counter + ramp engine in a single card.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Counter engine compressed into one card (DEC-83)

synergies.title: Glimpse Chain Draw
synergies.description: Cast Glimpse of Nature for {G}. Cast a 1-mana elf, draw a card. Heritage Druid taps three elves for {G}{G}{G} — fuel for more 1-drops. Quirion Ranger bounces a Forest to untap a creature for another mana elf activation, draw another card. With Eladamri topcasting an additional creature each turn, Glimpse turns 1-2 mana into 5-8 cards.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Combo-style draw engine (DEC-83)

synergies.title: Untap Loop
synergies.description: Two free untap effects per turn: Quirion Ranger bounces a Forest to untap any creature, and Wirewood Lodge spends {G} to untap target Elf. Both target Priest of Titania, Marwyn, or Elvish Archdruid for a second tap-for-mana. Net: 4-12 extra green mana per turn just from untapping the same elf two more times. Also enables a second Eladamri activation in the same turn.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Untap-based mana doubling (DEC-83)

synergies.title: Cheat Pile Density
synergies.description: Both new cheat targets resolve to full ETB value when put into play (rather than cast). Apex Altisaur fights an opposing creature on entry, then chains via Enrage. Worldspine Wurm is a 15/15 with trample that dies into three 5/5 wurms with trample. Eladamri reveals from top, Last March of the Ents deploys from hand, Ghalta dumps creatures from hand — all three cheat lines benefit from this pile.

highlights.name: Craterhoof Behemoth
highlights.reason: The deck's primary finisher. ETB gives all creatures +X/+X and trample where X is creature count. With 8-12 creatures in play, each swings for 10+ damage. Tutorable via Fierce Empath, cheatable via Eladamri's ability #3.

highlights.name: Priest of Titania
highlights.reason: Taps for one green mana per elf on the battlefield — including opponents' elves. With 16 elves in the deck plus token generation, routinely taps for 4-8 mana by turn 4. The deck's most explosive mana producer.

highlights.name: Champions of the Perfect
highlights.reason: 6/6 elf for {3}{G} that draws a card on every creature cast. Behold cost exiles an elf temporarily — with abundant elf tokens, the cost is trivial. Combined with Eladamri topcasting, draws 2-3 extra cards per turn. Returns the exiled elf on death for no net card loss.

highlights.name: Guardian Project
highlights.reason: Draw a card whenever a nontoken creature with a unique name enters. With 45 unique creatures, every creature resolving draws a card. Stacks with Champions of the Perfect and Leaf-Crowned Visionary for triple draw triggers.

highlights.name: Ezuri, Renegade Leader
highlights.reason: Elf lord with built-in overrun ({2}{G}{G}{G}: elves get +3/+3 and trample) and regeneration ({G}: regenerate another elf). Repeatable pump is a win condition on its own with enough mana. Regeneration protects key elves from removal and board wipes.

highlights.name: Leaf-Crowned Visionary
highlights.reason: Elf lord that gives other elves +1/+1 and draws a card whenever you cast an elf spell for {G} extra. With 16 elves in the deck, provides steady card flow. The +1/+1 anthem stacks with Dwynen and Elvish Archdruid.

highlights.name: Wirewood Symbiote
highlights.reason: Bounce an elf to hand to untap a creature — once per turn. Reuse ETB effects (Formidable Speaker tutor, Dwynen's Elite tokens, Reclamation Sage removal) while untapping Priest of Titania for double mana. The deck's key engine piece.

highlights.name: Ghalta, Stampede Tyrant
highlights.reason: ETB puts all creatures from hand onto the battlefield. Cheatable via Eladamri's ability #3 or Fierce Empath tutor. Deploying 3-5 creatures simultaneously from hand — potentially including Craterhoof — is typically game-ending.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Mass deploy finisher cheatable via Eladamri

highlights.name: Formidable Speaker
highlights.reason: Elf Druid with ETB creature tutor (discard a card to search for any creature). Untap ability provides extra value with Eladamri or mana elves. Wirewood Symbiote bounces it for repeatable tutoring. Finds Craterhoof, Fierce Empath, or any missing combo piece.

highlights.name: Fierce Empath
highlights.reason: Elf that tutors any creature with mana value 6+ to hand. Finds Craterhoof Behemoth, Ghalta, Void Winnower, Avenger of Zendikar, Apex Altisaur, or Worldspine Wurm. At 3 mana, slots perfectly into the curve. Eladamri then cheats the tutored creature into play.

highlights.name: Sensei's Divining Top
highlights.reason: Look at top 3, reorder at will. With Eladamri always seeing the top card, Top ensures a creature is always available for free casting. The draw-and-library ability provides emergency card draw. Not a Game Changer per official list.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Core Eladamri synergy piece — library manipulation

highlights.name: Skullclamp
highlights.reason: Draw 2 per 1-toughness creature death for {1} equip. The deck produces abundant 1/1 tokens from Dwynen's Elite, Elfsworn Giant, Tendershoot Dryad, Imperious Perfect, and Elvish Warmaster. Converts expendable tokens into cards at an extraordinary rate.

highlights.name: Finale of Devastation
highlights.reason: Tutor any creature from library or graveyard to battlefield. At X≥10, all creatures get +X/+X and haste — a second Craterhoof effect on a tutor. With Priest of Titania or Elvish Archdruid generating 8+ mana, X=10 is routine. Fills the deck's biggest gap: reliable creature tutoring beyond Fierce Empath.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Tutor + finisher in one card, filling the deck's primary strategic gap

highlights.name: Nature's Rhythm
highlights.reason: Creature tutor for {X}{G}{G} that puts directly onto battlefield. Harmonize lets you cast it again from graveyard, tapping a creature to reduce cost by its power — with a 5-power Elvish Archdruid, the second cast is nearly free. Two creature tutors for one card slot. From Tarkir: Dragonstorm.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Double-use tutor with efficient Harmonize recursion

highlights.name: Growing Rites of Itlimoc
highlights.reason: ETB looks at top 4 cards for a creature (45-creature deck = ~87% hit rate). Flips at end step with 4+ creatures into Itlimoc, Cradle of the Sun — taps for {G} per creature you control. Effectively Gaea's Cradle that enters as an enchantment. Powers massive Finale of Devastation X values.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Budget Gaea's Cradle that flips trivially in this deck

highlights.name: Nykthos, Shrine to Nyx
highlights.reason: Legendary land. Pay {2}, tap: add {G} per green devotion. In mono-green with 30+ green pips across permanents (Elvish Archdruid alone is 3), Nykthos routinely adds 5-10 mana. Minimal deckbuilding cost — replaces one Forest. Enables turn 4-5 Finale for X=10+.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: Devotion-based mana land, near-free inclusion in mono-green

highlights.name: The Great Henge
highlights.reason: CMC 9 but reduced by greatest power among creatures (usually costs 2-4 mana). Taps for {G}{G} + 2 life. Every nontoken creature entering gets a +1/+1 counter and draws a card. The counter pumps Marwyn into massive mana, and the draw stacks with Champions of the Perfect, Guardian Project, and Leaf-Crowned Visionary for triple-trigger card flow. Combines mana, draw, and growth in one card.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: All-in-one engine: mana + draw + counter synergy

highlights.name: Last March of the Ents
highlights.reason: Uncounterable sorcery for {6}{G}{G}. Draw cards equal to greatest toughness among your creatures (Quickbeam is 5/6, Craterhoof is 5/5, Void Winnower is 11/9), then put any number of creature cards from hand onto the battlefield. One card that refills hand and deploys an army.

sources.name: Claude analysis
sources.detail: High-impact draw + mass deploy spell

highlights.name: Avenger of Zendikar
highlights.reason: Creates a 0/1 Plant token for each land you control on ETB — typically 5-8 tokens. Each subsequent landfall puts a +1/+1 counter on every Plant. With Parallel Lives, creates 10-16 tokens that immediately start growing. Cheatable via Eladamri.

highlights.name: Sapling Nursery
highlights.reason: Enchantment with Affinity for Forests — costs {G}{G} with 6+ Forests in a 27-Forest deck. Landfall creates a 3/4 green Treefolk token with reach every land drop. Stacks with Elfsworn Giant, Scute Swarm, and Springheart Nantuko for 4+ tokens per land. Doubled by Parallel Lives and Second Harvest. Exile mode grants Treefolk and Forests indestructible as a board-wipe safety valve.

highlights.name: Badgermole Cub
highlights.reason: 2-mana creature that adds {G} whenever you tap a creature for mana. Amplifies Priest of Titania, Elvish Archdruid, and all mana elves. With Elven Chorus making all creatures tap for mana, each creature on board produces an extra {G}. ETB earthbend creates a 1/1 land-creature with haste — extra body for Eladamri's tap ability and another untapped elf for Heritage Druid.

highlights.name: Heritage Druid
highlights.reason: 1-mana 1/1 Elf Druid. Tap three untapped Elves you control: add {G}{G}{G}. With token producers like Imperious Perfect, Elvish Warmaster, Dwynen's Elite, and Elfsworn Giant, easy to assemble three untapped elves on turn 2-3 for a free triple-green burst. Pairs explosively with Quirion Ranger and Wirewood Lodge to untap producers for double activations.

highlights.name: Marwyn, the Nurturer
highlights.reason: 3-mana Legendary Elf Druid. Whenever another Elf you control enters, put a +1/+1 counter on Marwyn. Tap to add {G} equal to her power. Triple duty: ramp + counter accumulator + payoff for itself. With 21 elves in the deck plus token elf production, Marwyn routinely taps for 4-8 mana by turn 5.

highlights.name: Glimpse of Nature
highlights.reason: 1-mana sorcery. Whenever you cast a creature spell this turn, draw a card. With Heritage Druid, Quirion Ranger, and 21 elves enabling chain casts in one turn, a Glimpse turn frequently draws 4-8 cards. Eladamri's topcasting plus Quirion Ranger's Forest-bounce untap loop turns Glimpse into a one-card refill engine.

highlights.name: Quirion Ranger
highlights.reason: 1-mana Elf Ranger. Once per turn, return a Forest you control to hand to untap target creature. Untaps Priest of Titania, Marwyn, Elvish Archdruid, or Eladamri for a second activation each turn. Net: free Forest-replay plus an extra mana elf tap or extra Eladamri cheat per turn. The deck's single highest-leverage 1-drop.

highlights.name: Apex Altisaur
highlights.reason: 9-CMC 10/10 Dinosaur. ETB fights up to one creature you don't control. Enrage: when dealt damage, fights again. Cheatable via Eladamri or Last March of the Ents — full ETB removal value when cheated, unlike cascade-based alternatives. Doubles as the deck's flexible removal answer at the top end.

highlights.name: Worldspine Wurm
highlights.reason: 11-CMC 15/15 Wurm with Trample. Dies → 3x 5/5 trample Wurm tokens, then shuffles back to library. Cheatable via Eladamri, Last March, or Ghalta — full death-trigger value regardless of how it entered. The shuffle-back also reloads Eladamri's topcasting pool with another massive cheat target.
